chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

Insulting the believer is depravity, fighting him is kufr (disbelief), consuming his flesh is among disobedience to Allah, the Exalted, and the sanctity of his wealth is like the sanctity of his blood.

key_terms.أَكْلُ لَحْمِهِ: A metaphor for backbiting and violating a believer’s honor.
key_terms.حُرْمَةُ مَالِهِ: The inviolable sanctity of a believer’s property.
key_terms.فُسُوقٌ: Grave disobedience and departure from upright conduct.
key_terms.كَحُرْمَةِ دَمِهِ: Like the sanctity of his blood, indicating the highest level of protection.
key_terms.كُفْرٌ: Kufr (disbelief), expressing the extreme severity of the act.
key_terms.مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: An act of disobedience against Allah, the Exalted.

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about insulting, fighting, backbiting, and violating the property of a believer?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the grave sanctity of the believer in speech, life, honor, and property. It condemns verbal abuse, violent aggression, and backbiting, while affirming that a believer’s wealth is inviolable just like his blood.
